title: May Edition: Newly Issued Patents
summary_en: Congratulations to Purdue University researchers who recently received 10 patents on their intellectual property from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

title: ROWMow Sim: Purdue and INDOT collaborate for safer highway mowing
summary_en: Led by John Evans, assistant professor of agricultural and biological engineering (ABE) in Purdue’s College of Agriculture and mechanical engineering (by courtesy) in the College of Engineering, the project explores whether autonomous mowing systems could improve safety and efficiency.
title_cn: ROWMow Sim: Purdue and INDOT collaborate for safer highway mowing

title: New director Tort's experience, connections primed to advance OPP mission
summary_en: Joe Tort was named director of the Office of Professional Practice on March 1, replacing civil engineering professor Phillip Dunston, who had held the director role since April 2023.
title_cn: New director Tort's experience, connections primed to advance OPP mission
